Question B-001-014-011.

Why the correct answer is right: The official answer states that Canadian amateur stations may provide third-party communications with any other amateur radio station.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "only with countries that have third-party traffic agreements with Canada": The bank does not restrict Canadian third-party traffic only to countries with specific third-party traffic agreements.
- sourceIndex 2: "on frequencies assigned to the Canadian Forces Affiliate Radio Service (CFARS)": Canadian Forces Affiliate Radio Service frequencies are not the permission path for amateur third-party communications in this question.
- sourceIndex 3: "only in cases of emergencies or disaster relief": Emergencies and disaster relief are not the only allowed cases in the Canadian answer.
